title: Distribution-memory waste for the fed vortices, and dm/sw as the axis of the trait cloud's extent
summary: Random-feature waste (24 cos/sin channels, orthogonal frequencies) on c58's trait3d world, seed 6 standard memory and seed 10 long memory, T=10000, paired with c61's mean-waste and kind-blind runs on the same seeds; and a dm/sw test on c61's seed 15 (dm 0.2/sw 0.4 and dm 0.8/sw 0.8 against c61's dm 0.4 at sw 0.4 and 0.8).
